slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：御兽：开局炼妖壶，吞噬就变强第一卷：默认第924章王家王麻！
（..la）放话敲打完盗天鲲尊，夜玄不再多言。
金翅鹏鸟振翅穿破夜色，在月光下划出一道金色轨迹。
夜玄坐在鹏鸟背上，晚风拂面，带着几分咸湿海潮气息，心情却前所未有的轻快。
不多时，夜家府邸在夜色中露出轮廓。
府中灯火通明，颇为热闹。
收起金翅鹏鸟，夜玄没有惊动太多人，只是与老爹夜虎简单打了声招呼。
夜虎见夜玄平安归来，说了一句回来就好，便由着夜玄去了。
在福伯引领下，夜玄来到一处清净庭院。
庭院不大，收拾得干净雅致，几株青竹在夜风中沙沙作响。
夜玄抬手一挥。
银光闪烁，长宫芸与长宫月的身影已是从须弥心空间中出现，落在庭院中。
二女落地环顾四周，见是夜玄，方才放下心。
“夜郎，须弥心得变化，当真是好大。”
长宫芸上前一步，说不出的惊叹。
“习惯就好。”
夜玄应着，在石凳上坐下。
长宫芸自然的走到他身后，玉手轻搭，力道适中地揉捏起来。
长宫月则陪坐在一旁，替夜玄斟茶。
夜玄闭上眼，开始规划起妖宠培养方案。
“炼妖壶一层空间。”
“已经融合那截塔身，拥有三倍时间流速。”
“再搭配上金色压缩灵液，修炼将会事半功倍，如虎添翼。”
夜玄睁开眼，抬手一挥，银光闪烁间，数道身影被唤出，落在庭院中。
庭院瞬间被填满。
混世魔猿挠了挠脑袋，有些不明所以，青兽青冥十二对青翅收拢，鸟眸静静望着夜玄，巴掌大小的金寿龟趴在小凛冬龙头顶，只露出圆润脑袋，一脸懒散。
“湫湫、小九、猴子、龟龟、青冥、小胖墩。”
夜玄目光扫过几只妖宠，带着几分不容商量的意味，通过兽契传递消息：
“你们六个，从今日起进入炼妖壶一层，借助金色压缩灵液修炼，争取早日踏入八阶。”
湫湫苦着一张小脸，垂头丧气地趴在漂浮泡泡上，就连头顶上的小王冠也变得萎靡。
完啦，不能出去玩了。
其他几只妖宠闻声倒是没有太大反应。

(..la) After speaking and beating Lord Thief Kun, Ye Xuan said no more.
The golden-winged roc flapped its wings through the night, drawing a golden trail under the moonlight.
Ye Xuan sat on the back of Pengniao, with the evening breeze blowing on his face, carrying a bit of the salty and wet sea tide, but his mood was lighter than ever.
Not long after, the outline of the Ye family mansion was revealed in the night.
The mansion was brightly lit and quite lively.
Putting away the golden-winged roc, Ye Xuan did not disturb too many people, but simply said hello to his father Ye Hu.
Seeing that Ye Xuan had returned safely, Yehu said it would be good to come back and left Ye Xuan alone.
Under the guidance of Uncle Fu, Ye Xuan came to a pure courtyard.
The courtyard is small, clean and elegant, with a few green bamboos rustling in the night wind.
Ye Xuan raised his hand and waved.
Silver light flashed, and the figures of Chang Gong Yun and Chang Gong Yue appeared from the Sumeru Heart Space and landed in the courtyard.
The two girls landed and looked around, and were relieved when they saw it was Ye Xuan.
"Yelang, the change in Xumi's mind is really great."
Chang Gongyun took a step forward and was amazed beyond words.
"Just get used to it."
Ye Xuan responded and sat down on the stone bench.
Chang Gongyun walked up behind him naturally, put her jade hands lightly, and started kneading with moderate strength.
Chang Gongyue sat beside him and poured tea for Ye Xuan.
Ye Xuan closed his eyes and began to plan a demon pet training plan.
"The first level of the Demon Refining Pot."
"It has been fused with that part of the tower body, and has three times the time flow rate."
"Coupled with the golden compressed spiritual fluid, cultivation will be more effective with half the effort, making it even more powerful."
Ye Xuan opened his eyes and raised his hand. In the flash of silver light, several figures were summoned and landed in the courtyard.
The courtyard was filled instantly.
The Hunshi Demon Ape scratched his head, a little confused. The twelve pairs of green wings of the green beast Qingming were folded, and its bird eyes looked at Ye Xuan quietly. The palm-sized Golden Life Turtle lay on the head of the little Cold Winter Dragon, with only its round head exposed and a lazy look on its face.
"Qiuqiu, Xiaojiu, Monkey, Guigui, Qingming, Xiaopangdun."
Ye Xuan glanced at several demon pets, and with a bit of non-negotiable meaning, he conveyed the message through the beast contract:
"The six of you, starting today, enter the first level of the Demon Refining Pot, practice with the help of golden compressed spiritual liquid, and strive to reach the eighth level as soon as possible."
"Qiu~"
Qiuqiu lay on the floating bubbles dejectedly with a sad face, and even the little crown on her head became sluggish.
It’s over, we can’t go out to play anymore.
The other demon pets didn't react much when they heard the sound.
